549-997-6871--211.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the earthbend creature.
549-997-6871--211.description:
Cast the earthbend creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent creature.
When the creature dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the creature enters, it triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's an artifact due to Biotransference, thus making it also a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat from step 3.
549-997-6871--211.notes: Depending on the earthbend creature used, you may receive additional results. There may also be needed prerequisites that are specific for each card (such as Bumi, King of Three Trials which requires a Lesson in your graveyard).

618-1938-4247.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Glorious Protector.
When the Glorious Protector token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Glorious Protector leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Glorious Protector token.
When the Glorious Protector token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

5078-6666-7356.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Longshot.
Longshot triggers, dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2506-4365-4836-7150.description:
Cast Kirol by paying {1}{R/W}{R/W}
When Kirol enters, Molten Echoes triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kirol by tapping it and another creature you control, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Resolve the copy of Molten Echoes's ability, creating two token copies of Kirol with haste.
Holding priority, activate a Kirol token by tapping both Kirol tokens, copying Molten Echoes's trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1494-5636-7720-7737.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Psychic Frog by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

323-2173-5220-6505.description:
Activate Spore Frog by sacrificing it.
When Spore Frog dies, Mortuary and Falkenrath Noble trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Spore Frog from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Falkenrath Noble trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Spore Frog ability.
Cast Spore Frog from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

567-5641-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
567-5641-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

891-2843-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1550-2105-7175.notablePrerequisites:
Sword of Hearth and Home attached to any creature you control except Combat Celebrant.
An opponent is unable to block Combat Celebrant or the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
You have not exerted Combat Celebrant this turn.
1550-2105-7175.description:
Declare the creature with Sword of Hearth and Home and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature that has Sword of Hearth and Home attached.
Sword of Hearth and Home triggers, exiling Combat Celebrant, then causing you to search your library for a basic land card, then put the land and Combat Celebrant onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

628-3723-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Carnifex Demon.
When Carnifex Demon dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-5089-6753.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Karn, the Great Creator.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

57-4235-4846-6791.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4235-4846-6791.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Rings of Brighthearth triggers, causing you to pay {2} to copy Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1563-2457-4365-7060.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

973-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Matter Reshaper
When Matter Reshaper dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Matter Reshaper from your graveyard onto the top of your library 
Resolve the Matter Reshaper trigger, revealing Matter Reshaper from the top of your library and putting it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

460-539-1129.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Allies.
460-539-1129.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Harabaz Druid.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

362-4321-6737.description:
Cause a noncreature artifact to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl if it isn't an Equipment already.
Barret's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a Food artifact token, which will be an Equipment due to Bludgeon Brawl.
Repeat step 2.
362-4321-6737.notes: The combo creates a mandatory infinite loop in step 2. This must be stopped at some point or the game ends in a draw.

632-647-2034-3621-5129.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Su-Chi Cave Guard, adding {C}{C}.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Cast Scarecrone by paying {3}.
When Scarecrone enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Scarecrone.
Activate the nontoken Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Su-Chi Cave Guard from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Su-Chi Cave Guard enters the battlefield, Mirrorworks triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken Scarecrone, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Mirrorworks trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Su-Chi Cave Guards, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Su-Chi Cave Guards die, they trigger, adding 16 {C}.
Activate the token Scarecrone's second ability by paying {4} and tapping it, returning Scarecrone from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
632-647-2034-3621-5129.notes: If you have mana available, you can instead sacrifice the Scarecrones to their first abilities.

2511-4484-4871-4924-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2511-4484-4871-4924-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2511-4484-4871-4924-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

944-1117-3689-6518.description:
Cast Junk Diver by paying {0}.
When Junk Diver enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Junk Diver and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Junk Diver dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {0}.
When Workshop Assistant enters the battlefield, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Workshop Assistant and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Junk Diver from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

730-1174-1479.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You control two lands that can tap to produce at least {2}, one of which must enter the battlefield untapped.
730-1174-1479.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Play the land returned to your hand in step 2.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers.
Holding priority, activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Oboro Breezecaller by paying {2} and returning one of the lands from the battlefield to your hand, untapping the other land.
Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a token.
Repeat from step 7.

1247-5845-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness and is modified.
1247-5845-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Orochi Merge-Keeper's ability by tapping it, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

549-1879-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to any other creature you control.
549-1879-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-1879-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1069-1374-4885-5499--24.notablePrerequisites:
You control three or more artifacts.
If the Knight has two colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of either color available.
If the Knight has three colored mana symbols in its mana cost, you have one mana of any of those colors, and two mana of any other one of those colors available.
1069-1374-4885-5499--24.description:
Activate Lotus Ring's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Knight.
Activate the Knight by tapping and sacrificing it, adding three mana of any color.
Cast the Knight from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
If the Knight has mana value 2 or less, this combo nets infinite mana.

240-643-1738-3466.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
240-643-1738-3466.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control by any method.
When that creature enters the battlefield, Reaper King triggers, destroying that creature.
Resolve Atla Palani's trigger, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2 until Serra Avatar enters the battlefield then dies, or until you choose to end the loop by destroying an opponent's permanent.
If Serra Avatar dies, it and Atla Palani trigger.
Resolve Serra Avatar's trigger, shuffling it into your library.
Continue from step 3.

1322-3259-4191-5022.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a nontoken creature you control with mana value 3 or less.
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 3 or less.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1322-3259-4191-5022.description:
Declare Treasury Thrull and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Treasury Thrull triggers, returning a creature card with mana value 3 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast the creature by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature with mana value 3 or less, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

366-500-4772-4840.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Myr Battlesphere and creating four token copies of it with base power and toughness equal to half the original Myr Battlesphere's power and toughness, rounded up.
When the Myr Battlesphere tokens enter the battlefield, each token triggers once and Purphoros triggers four times.
Resolve each Myr Battlesphere trigger, creating a total of 32 1/1 Myr artifact creature tokens, and triggering Purphoros 32 additional times.
Resolve all 36 Purphoros triggers, dealing 72 damage to each opponent.

3258-4899.description:
Activate Phyrexian Devourer by exiling the top card of your library.
Repeat step 1 until you have an empty library.
Resolve the first Phyrexian Devourer ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it.
If Phyrexian Devourer's power is at least seven, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
Repeat from step 3 for each remaining trigger.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying {6}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle it into your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Beacon of Tomorrows from your library.
Repeat from step 6.

814-2751-4659-4853.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least two Soldiers.
Myrel does not have summoning sickness.
814-2751-4659-4853.description:
Declare Myrel as an attacker, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Strionic Resonator by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Myrel's ability.
Resolve the copy of Myrel's ability, creating at least two 1/1 Soldier artifact creature tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Soldier, adding {C}{C}.
When the Soldier dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Strionic Resonator.
Repeat from step 2.

328-1056-2499.notablePrerequisites:
Gray Merchant in your graveyard.Araumi does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least three opponents.
You have at least three additional cards in your graveyard.
328-1056-2499.description:
Activate Araumi by tapping it and exiling three cards from your graveyard, giving Gray Merchant encore until end of turn.
Activate Gray Merchant's encore ability by paying {3}{B}{B} and exiling it from your graveyard, creating at least three token copies of it with haste.
The Gray Merchants enter the battlefield, triggering their abilities twice each.
Resolve the first Gray Merchant ability, causing each opponent to lose at least 8 life and you to gain at least 8 life.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining Gray Merchant trigger.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-411.description:
Activate Grinning Ignus by paying {R} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, adding {C}{C}{R}.
Cast Grinning Ignus by paying {2}{R}.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Repeat.
